text:
sam_sales: quick handoff for Nimbus Health (enterprise). signed MSA pending BAA. deal: $220k ARR, term starts 2026-05-15. they're asking for a 4-week onboarding timeline, private deployment (VPC), and dedicated capacity. main risks: SAML attribute mapping, network egress rules, and KMS/HSM key management. i'll intro during kickoff tomorrow at 10am PT. tagging cs/support/eng. :handshake:

maria_cs: thanks — i'll own onboarding. needs: (1) SSO setup (Okta) w/ attribute map, (2) detailed network allowlist (CIDR + outbound domains), (3) confirmation of model delivery (hosted registry vs air-gapped bundle), (4) logging configuration (disable payload logging). can you drop the IdP metadata and point of contact?

sam_sales: copying what i have: they use Okta; IdP metadata XML in my notes (will send via secure share). CIDR for their VPN egress: 34.120.0.0/20. outbound domains they care about: our model registry s3.redwood-inference.com, license & health endpoints at telemetry.redwood-inference.com. POC: elena@ Nimbus (Elena Park, infra lead). BAA is with legal, status: awaiting signature — CS, please flag as blocker for production.

jordan_support: got it. For private deploy (VPC): we need exact CIDRs, list of NAT egress IPs if any, and whether they require model weights to stay on-prem (air-gapped). If hosted registry is acceptable we pull from s3; otherwise we'll package an airgap bundle and share an install image. Also clarify log retention; if disabling payload logging, confirm which telemetry we can still collect (metrics/health only?).

lee_eng: we can support Okta SAML. common attribute mappings we recommend: email -> urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3, name -> urn:oid:2.5.4.3, groups -> urn:oid:2.5.4.11. if they need email_verified we can map a custom claim. sample assertion we need: NameID, email, groups. For KMS/HSM: we support KMS integrations (AWS KMS or customer HSM via KMIP). Need reply from security on HSM rotation policy. For private deploy image: default is images pulled from our registry (requires whitelisting s3 endpoints). We can provide an OCI image they can pull from their registry or a tarball for air-gapped installs.

onboard-bot: NOTE: kickoff call scheduled 2026-05-04 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent to sam_sales, maria_cs, elena@nimbus, lee_eng. Please add any prereq docs to the kickoff thread.

maria_cs: initial plan (owner tags): Week 0 (pre-kickoff) - sam to share IdP metadata + CIDR + legal status (owner: sam_sales). Week 1 - SSO integration + network allowlist test (owners: lee_eng + elena). Week 2 - Private deploy staging (owners: eng + support). Week 3 - data connections + embeddings verification (owners: cs + support). Week 4 - production cutover + runbook handoff (owners: cs + eng).

sam_sales: confirming i'll share IdP metadata via secure link today and introduce elena on the kickoff invite. BAA is on legal's side, will chase and update post-call.

jordan_support: action items for support: (1) prepare whitelist doc with domains and IP ranges we require, (2) prepare air-gapped install checklist (image tarball, signature, checksums), (3) list telemetry options when payload logging disabled. ETA: 48 hours for docs.

lee_eng: action items for eng: (1) share SAML attribute mapping template + sample assertion (I'll drop into the kickoff doc), (2) confirm KMS/HSM options and rotation constraints w/ security (I'll sync with sec team), (3) prepare instructions for OCI image push to customer registry or packaging steps for air-gapped bundle. ETA: 72 hours for initial artifacts.

maria_cs: i'll draft the onboarding runbook and onboarding checklist and share with the group before kickoff. i'll also add a renewal-risk note: their procurement cycle is strict; if onboarding slips >6 weeks after term start we surface to RevOps.

onboard-bot: Reminder: add any sensitive attachments to the secure docs locker and mark as restricted.

sam_sales: thanks team. tagging: @maria_cs (owner), @lee_eng (eng SSO + KMS), @jordan_support (private deploy + airgap), @elena (customer). i'll follow up with the IdP XML and legal update.

maria_cs: thanks — i'll run the kickoff and post a weekly status summary in this thread.
